summary: Complaints centre on sugarcane dues and fertiliser shortages with long queues at Baghra, and fatal crashes on the Baghra bypass of the Panipat-Khatima highway; the one sourced positive is a 2026 drinking-water scheme inauguration in Charthawal Nagar Panchayat, but no source shows voters' views on it.

positives.english: Charthawal Nagar Panchayat's new drinking water scheme is complete
positives.hindi: चरथावल नगर पंचायत में नई पेयजल योजना बन गई है
positives.basis: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath inaugurated the drinking water reorganisation scheme of Nagar Panchayat Charthawal among 423 projects worth over Rs 951 crore in Muzaffarnagar (Webdunia Hindi, updated 13 Apr 2026). The same list is in Prokerala (aggregator, 14 Apr 2026). This is a government completion; the sources do not report voters' views on it.

positives.english: *Highway access makes it easy to reach mandis and towns from Baghra
positives.hindi: *हाईवे पास होने से बघरा से मंडी-शहर जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: no source found on voters' views of roads or access. The Panipat-Khatima highway runs past the Baghra bypass (Amar Ujala, 2025-10-01, see negative 4), so access is a plausible strength but is unverified.

positives.english: *Sugarcane is a cash crop here, and mills in the area take it
positives.hindi: *गन्ने से नकदी मिलती है, मिलें गन्ना खरीदती हैं
positives.basis: Inference: sugarcane is the main cash crop in the district (Amar Ujala, 2025-12-05, district-level), but no source says voters see it as a positive. Dues are a complaint (negative 1).

positives.english: *The cooperative committee at Baghra still supplies fertiliser to farmers
positives.hindi: *बघरा की सहकारी समिति से खाद मिलने का सहारा अब भी है
positives.basis: Inference: the Baghra committee is a working distribution point (Amar Ujala, 2025-06-27 and 2025-07-04), and its supply is also the main complaint (negatives 2 and 3). Value as a positive is unverified.

positives.english: *Charthawal's market gives daily essentials close to home
positives.hindi: *चरथावल के बाजार में रोजमर्रा का सामान पास में मिल जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: Charthawal is a Nagar Panchayat and development block (Wikipedia, Charthawal Assembly constituency). No source on market access was found.

negatives.english: Sugarcane dues are still stuck with the mills, and the price is too low
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का बकाया मिलों पर अटका है, और भाव भी कम है
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala (Muzaffarnagar, 5 Dec 2025) reports that Bajaj group's 14 mills owe farmers more than Rs 100 crore, and that the cane price is inadequate (UP Rs 400/quintal, against Haryana Rs 415 and Punjab Rs 416). The article attributes these points to SP MP Harendra Malik.

negatives.english: At Baghra, urea is not available, and farmers go home empty-handed
negatives.hindi: बघरा में यूरिया नहीं मिलती, किसान खाली हाथ लौटते हैं
negatives.basis: AC-specific. Amar Ujala video report (Dimple Sirohi, 27 Jun 2025) describes a ruckus at Sadhan Sahkari Samiti, Baghra, where farmers from six villages returned without urea. The farmers' allegation of unfair distribution is their claim, not verified.

negatives.english: At the Baghra committee, fertiliser queues are long and staff arrive late
negatives.hindi: बघरा समिति पर खाद की लंबी लाइन, कर्मचारी देर से आते हैं
negatives.basis: AC-specific. Amar Ujala video report (4 Jul 2025) says a long queue of farmers formed at the Baghra cooperative committee on the Panipat-Khatima highway, staff arrived late, and urea distribution began only in the afternoon. Farmers' complaint.

negatives.english: On the Baghra bypass, a car hit a parked truck and six people died
negatives.hindi: बघरा बाईपास पर खड़े ट्रक से कार टकराई, छह लोगों की जान गई
negatives.basis: AC-specific location. Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2025) reports a car ran into a truck parked at a dhaba on the Baghra bypass of the Panipat-Khatima highway; six people died and one was injured.

negatives.english: *Stray cattle eat the crop and farmers cannot protect their fields
negatives.hindi: *आवारा पशु फसल खा जाते हैं, खेत की रखवाली मुश्किल है
negatives.basis: Inference: stray cattle is a common farm complaint in western UP, but no source specific to Charthawal or Muzaffarnagar was found in two searches (Hindi and English). Field check needed.

notes: Identity re-verified on the Wikipedia AC page: AC 12, Charthawal, Muzaffarnagar district, reserved status None (SC-reserved 1967-2008). Current MLA Pankaj Kumar Malik (SP), elected 2022. Baghra is listed as part of the constituency. Other listed places: Charthawal (Nagar Panchayat), Kutesra, Dhindhawali, Nara, Jarauda, Bahadarpur, Lachheda, Sujru, Bihari, Harsauli, Tawli, Simli, Vahalana, Nirmana, and Barwala (Kukra). The Assembly factbook PDF could not be read (scanned). Negatives 2, 3 and 4 are AC-specific (Baghra). Negative 1 (sugarcane dues) is district-level. Negative 5 is an unsourced inference. Positive 1 is a government inauguration, not a voter view. Positives 2-5 remain unsourced inferences and need a field check. The Muzaffarnagar district page (muzaffarnagar.nic.in) returned HTTP 503 and was not used. Original Hindi outlet (Amar Ujala or Dainik Jagran) coverage of the April 2026 inauguration was not found. The Baghra bypass crash is a single incident, so it is not evidence of a recurring hazard. About 25 searches were run; no quota limit was hit. Next: Hindi local searches for Baghra CHC or hospital, Pinna area, and nearest sugar mill names. P1 weak positive: the source reports a government inauguration, not a voter view of the scheme.

round2.changes: Verified all 4 original negative sources (Amar Ujala 27 Jun, 4 Jul, 1 Oct 2025; 5 Dec 2025). Removed unsupported details: 'routinely told to come back', 'one family', 'Karnal', and the Lok Sabha attribution. Added a sourced positive (Charthawal Nagar Panchayat drinking-water scheme inaugurated, Apr 2026, Webdunia Hindi plus Prokerala aggregator). Replaced the unsourced 'villagers help each other' positive. Confirmed Baghra is in Charthawal AC (Wikipedia). Re-ranked negatives: sugarcane dues (district-wide) to 1, Baghra urea to 2, queues to 3, bypass crash to 4. Shortened Hindi lines: negative 3 from 17 words to 12; positives 2, 3, 5 trimmed to 10-12 words.
